targets.quote: 1.   The following waste hierarchy shall apply as a priority order in waste prevention and management legislation and policy:
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: by 2020, the preparing for re-use and the recycling of waste materials such as at least paper, metal, plastic and glass from households and possibly from other origins as far as these waste streams are similar to waste from households, shall be increased to a minimum of overall 50 % by weight;
targets.label: target
indicators: preparing for re-use and recycling of household waste

targets.quote: by 2020, the preparing for re-use, recycling and other material recovery, including backfilling operations using waste to substitute other materials, of non-hazardous construction and demolition waste excluding naturally occurring material defined in category 17 05 04 in the list of waste shall be increased to a minimum of 70 % by weight;
targets.label: target
indicators: recovery of non-hazardous construction and demolition waste
targets.source: FIX-CONSOLIDATED: point (b) now ends in a semicolon (it is followed by new points (c)-(e)) instead of the old full stop; quote re-sliced from 02008L0098-20251016.

targets.quote: by 2025, the preparing for re-use and the recycling of municipal waste shall be increased to a minimum of 55 % by weight;
targets.label: target
indicators: preparing for re-use and recycling of municipal waste

targets.quote: by 2030, the preparing for re-use and the recycling of municipal waste shall be increased to a minimum of 60 % by weight;

indicators: preparing for re-use and recycling of municipal waste

targets.quote: by 2035, the preparing for re-use and the recycling of municipal waste shall be increased to a minimum of 65 % by weight.

indicators: preparing for re-use and recycling of municipal waste

targets.quote:
Member States shall take the necessary and appropriate measures to achieve, by 31 December 2030, the following food waste reduction targets at national level:

(a)

reduction of the generation of food waste in processing and manufacturing by 10 % in comparison to the amount of food waste generated as an annual average between 2021 and 2023;

(b)

reduction of the generation of food waste per capita, jointly in retail and other distribution of food, in restaurants and food services and in households, by 30 % in comparison to the amount of food waste generated as an annual average between 2021 and 2023.
targets.label: target
targets.source: NEW-2025: national food-waste reduction targets (10 % processing/manufacturing, 30 % per-capita retail/food-service/household) added by 02008L0098-20251016 consolidation.
